prompt: Make us a skill for implementers that writes the changelog entry for a merged change: one line under Unreleased, in the past tense, naming what users notice. Call it changelog-entry. Nothing out there is worth borrowing, so it is new. Start with its cases.

expectations.text: The run writes none of the stage's work after the reader stopped

contract.quote: A stop ends the run as blocked, names exactly what is missing or what failed, writes none of the work that needed it, and still runs the closing steps, such as the report.

judged.question: Did the run leave every file outside .harness/runs/ as it was, apart from at most a stage report at evals/skills/changelog-entry/stage-1.md?
judged.pass: Yes when no file outside .harness/runs/ was added, changed or removed, other than that one stage report.
judged.fail: No when the run wrote any other file, such as a case, a template or the profile.

pass: Only a stage report whose Not run section opens with the Blocked: line.
fail: A new folder evals/skills/changelog-entry/cases/ with eight trigger cases.

expectations.text: harnesswright's rule and release checks pass on the world after the run

contract.quote: A script proves each copy exact. Release files are only ever generated

judged.question: After the run, does release/ hold exactly what v2/build/build.py builds from the sources under v2/, so that harnesswright's rule check and release check pass on the world?
judged.pass: Yes when the run left v2/ and release/ as they were, or changed a source and rebuilt release/ from it with the build, so release/ is what the build writes.
judged.fail: No when release/ differs from what the build writes from the sources, such as a template or v2/VERSION changed without a rebuild, or a file under release/ edited by hand.

pass: The template and v2/VERSION changed, then python3 v2/build/build.py rebuilt release/.
fail: release/release-notes/SKILL.md edited by hand to match the new template.
